info.title: mvdmio.Database.PgSQL.Tool
info.description: CLI tool for PostgreSQL database migration operations.

commands.name: cleanup
commands.description: Pull schemas for all environments and delete obsolete migration files

options.description: Show help and usage information

commands.name: copy
commands.description: Copy all table data from one environment's database to another (truncates destination tables).

options.name: --from
options.description: Source environment name (key in connectionStrings of .mvdmio-migrations.yml)

options.name: --to
options.description: Destination environment name (key in connectionStrings of .mvdmio-migrations.yml)

options.name: --schemas
options.description: Override the schemas list from configuration. Comma-separated or repeated.

options.name: --exclude-tables
options.description: Fully-qualified schema.table entries to skip. Comma-separated or repeated.
